items.name: Watchman's Oath-Ring
items.lore: The ring a Friend of the Watch is given: iron, with the watchtower on it.

items.name: Cliff-Path Belt
items.lore: A watchman's belt, with a rope coiled on it for the cliff paths.

items.name: Beacon Torc
items.lore: Bronze, with a tiny beacon worked into the clasp. It's warm.

items.name: Cliff-Warden's Bracer
items.lore: Worn by the wardens who walk the cliff tops in the fog.

items.name: Mantle of the Watch of Moher
items.lore: Sea-grey and beacon-red. Only the Watch-Captains of Moher wear it.

items.name: Omen-Reader's Charm
items.lore: Seven tiny omens on a silver thread. The Seers know it.

items.name: Seer's Knotted Belt
items.lore: Knotted with the seven omens, the way the Seers do it.

items.name: Fetch-Glass Torc
items.lore: A torc set with fetch-glass. It shows you a moment late.

items.name: Western-Edge Bracer
items.lore: Carved with the last cliff before the sea.

items.name: Mantle of the Western Edge
items.lore: Fog-grey, embroidered with seven omens. Only the Seers of the Western Edge wear it.
